messages:
sarah: quick flag — during the compliance runbook review I ran an audit coverage diff and found several gaps across services. short list: API gateway not emitting request_id on 5xx, auth service missing role_change events, console missing admin-config-change events, billing not logging invoice.downloads, runtime not including image provenance and actor schema inconsistent with our standard. also customer-managed KMS usage isn't being surfaced into customer audit events. can we triage and queue? :eyes:

mike: thanks for catching — this is high priority for customer evidence. propose triage steps: 1) map each missing event to an owner 2) draft minimal schema patch for backward compatibility 3) classify hotfix vs backlog. i'll pick up API gateway + runtime. assigning @anika to auth.

anika: taking auth. question: for RBAC changes do we log both before & after role bindings, or just the delta? compliance usually wants both. leaning to both with redaction rules for PII. cc @jordan for KMS integration detail.

jordan: for KMS — current CMK flow writes key usage to cloud provider logs but we never join those to outgoing audit events. options: 1) a sync job that pulls KMS Audit entries into our audit pipeline (low effort, eventual consistency) 2) service-level instrumentation that emits a KMS.key_use event at call time (real-time, more code). leaning to #2 for security-critical ops. also we need an HSM/KMS field in the event schema.

admin: note: vulnerability triage flagged audit schema mismatch as a medium finding last week — linking here. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFSEC-1299

sarah: quick schema sketch (for discussion):
```json
{
  "event_type": "role.updated",
  "actor": { "id": "u-123", "type": "user|service", "principal": "email@org.com" },
  "before": { "roles": ["viewer"] },
  "after": { "roles": ["admin", "viewer"] },
  "target": { "id": "svc-456", "type": "service" },
  "kms": { "key_id": "projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/k", "mode": "cmk|platform" }
}
```

mike: +1 to including before/after for RBAC. for API gateway i'll open a quick PR to add request_id and propagate trace_id into audit events. low-risk patch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-gateway/pull/458

anika: auth PR incoming — will emit role.change.{requested,applied} pair and include actor.principal. putting a hard stop on PII in logs; redact emails unless customer opt-in.

jordan: i'll draft the KMS key_use event to be emitted synchronously for CMK ops. need guidance on retention tagging for compliance export.

audit-bot: schema_validator: detected 3 failures for service=runtime between 2026-03-16 and 2026-03-18 — actor object did not include "type" field. link: https://builds.redwood-infra/validators/2345

sarah: action items (short):
- mike: add gateway request_id + trace propagation (PR opened)
- anika: auth role_change events + redact rules (PR wip)
- jordan: KMS key_use event design + retention tags (docs + PR)
- mike: runtime actor schema followup (add type + validate)
- sarah: create triage tickets and schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT

mike: added backlog tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-3421 (api-gw), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-3422 (runtime actor schema)

anika: created auth ticket INFSEC-3430 and set priority=high for customer auditability

sarah: thanks all. please update the tickets when PRs are ready and add test vectors for the new events. i'll run the customer-facing validation checklist after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
